scope: Independent Decimal reconstruction from operating, corporate, tax, treasury and packaging policies. No import or execution of the production valuation engine; no changed assumptions.

arithmetic_audit.operating_scope: Rebuilt 2026server base from issuer anchors and selected Q4bridge; compounded revised ASP with preserved units; charged 50% incremental consolidated EBIT tapering 32%, unchanged Foundry, addedcapital/D&A/WC, corporate SBC, minority and all-in lease cash. Packaging overlap/profit and cash added once; host capital denominator excludes packaging.
arithmetic_audit.financing_scope: Rebuilt treasury including ordinary/capitalized interest, after-tax cash income, conditional tax shields, maturity paydowns, government cash and Classiq cash. Recomputed explicit operating DCF,3% terminal and flat debt financing shield tail at 11/12/13% controls.

interpretation_notes: Passed arithmetic does not empirically validate 20% ASP, 50% incremental profit retention,0.80 capital productivity,12% discount rate or the cash tax/claim proxies.

The 20% ASP choice was made with the prior 19.1667% revenue-offset diagnostic known; chronology is disclosed and should not be rewritten as blind selection. This audit cannot establish motive from that proximity.
The 2031 switch to aggregate D&A normalization replaces the small incremental asset cohort schedule. It must not be described as an exact asset-vintage replacement ledger.
End 2026 is a planning reference from forecast opening 2027 financial balances, not measured November 4 fair value; intrinsic endpoints do not forecast market-convergence dates.

competition_direction_check.provisional_choice: Intel SHORT remains the valuation-consistent provisional pitch direction, with materially reduced conviction. It must be framed as current overvaluation exposed during the investment ramp, not a passive short held unchanged for four or five years.
competition_direction_check.why_not_automatic_reversal_to_LONG: Higher ASP improves the business and raises value. It does not by itself make the dated $58.11 entry cheap: the end 2026 reference is 41.68 at 12%, and 48.14 at 11%. These are planning references, not exact November 4 marks. The positive 2030/2031 endpoint prices represent value accumulating over time, not an attractive risk-adjusted purchase price established today.
competition_direction_check.own_repricing_judgment: I would provisionally expect the large 2027 cash investment and the distinction between premium-product earnings and owner cash to create an opportunity for valuation compression in 2027–2028, before the recovery compounds into the entry price. This is an explicit, moderate-conviction market expectation. The intrinsic model does not prove it; announced spending may already be understood and investors may continue looking through it.
competition_direction_check.material_downgrade: The old broad short narrative is no longer adequate. End 2029 value 57.50 is almost the entry 58.11 before carrying costs; end 2030/2031 values 63.81/70.53 are above it. Do not advertise the earlier 41.68 reference as a 3–5-year price target, assume the price must visit it, or call opportunity-cost underperformance a short profit.

what_the_cash_forecast_actually_says.interpretation: The case contains a strong recovery, positive 2028 cash and no required new debt. Funding failure, permanently negative cash conversion and collapse of AI demand are not its mechanisms.

competition_direction_check.strongest_LONG_argument: The accepted premium CPU mix, reuse of existing facilities and funded external packaging can generate durable earnings with improving capital productivity. That is a serious bull mechanism already partly incorporated. A stronger LONG would require actually preferring better returns, additional profitable external business or lower operating risk; do not insert unvalued foundry optionality merely to force a recommendation.
competition_direction_check.live_judge_objection: Why should I short a business whose cash flow and value grow into and then exceed today’s price, especially when capex and negative 2027 free cash are already public?
competition_direction_check.honest_answer: The only remaining basis is a present valuation discrepancy plus expected early repricing as the investment/ramp economics become concrete. I grant recovery, richer mix and a profitable packaging business; I still judge the entry too expensive for the cash path. However, the short becomes unattractive if investors retain the premium through 2029. I would reassess and cover when the value gap closes rather than defend a perpetual bearish position.
competition_direction_check.M37_boundary: The rules require a 3–5-year fundamental investment horizon, not a compulsory unchanged holding to one exact endpoint. Show the entire 2029–2031 economics and acknowledge that the expected realization is earlier. This is a defensible provisional interpretation, not organizer confirmation or a license to disguise a purely event-driven trade.
competition_direction_check.competition_strategy: Keep the updated pricing case prominently, explain why a successful operating recovery can still be an expensive entry, and rehearse the timing objection. Do not present this as a 9/10 thesis or a demonstrated winning recommendation. Its weaker realization case is a substantive issue, not failure to satisfy an arbitrary minimum return or prove the future.
competition_direction_check.what_changes_the_view: Sustained acceptance and pricing above the owned path, a better conversion of sales into group profit, or materially lower cash capital and supplier working-capital requirements would strengthen LONG and weaken SHORT. A credible funded external wafer program could add value. Conversely, price/mix fading sooner or a funded ramp producing less group cash would strengthen SHORT. Use the observable joint operating/cash result rather than insisting on unavailable exact component allocation.
competition_direction_check.no_forced_direction_control: The initial SHORT is not preserved as an invariant. This review keeps it provisionally because the preferred early valuation remains below the entry, while explicitly abandoning the old claim of a material passive 3–5-year short payoff. If root does not independently own early repricing, the correct action is to withdraw that recommendation rather than cite this audit as evidence that it is attractive.
